If there is a formal hold reason or internal ticket number, please include it so we can coordinate with our tax team. To avoid late fees, we’re happy to accelerate anything we can provide.

Rohan,

Thanks — saw Elena’s reply and the AP hold note. Finance reviewed the ledger: outstanding amount is EUR 42,600 (net) + VAT where applicable. A few points and a proposed next step:

1) Immediate actions we can take:
   - Provide a line-level VAT breakdown and supplier EU VAT registration (I can produce these by EOD tomorrow).
   - Confirm our billing entity and whether reverse-charge applies for their jurisdiction.

2) Risk / collection posture:

   - If procurement insists on a credit note for the license adjustment, agree to net that against the outstanding and reissue an adjusted invoice.

Please confirm you’re comfortable escalating this to Vivek for approval of the settlement terms and to loop Monica for the procurement/contract angle. If Vivek approves, we’ll send a formal settlement/DocuSign package.

I will upload the settlement proposal and adjusted invoice to DocuSign once you confirm the credit note stance (link to follow). For transparency I’ve also created a HubSpot ticket: HS-123456 to track.

Please reply with availability for the short call and any additional documents AP needs. Appreciate the partnership and want to avoid service interruption while this is resolved.
